scope: User-authorized visualization only from saved V reduced graph; no graph reconstruction/threshold/model change
selection_order: Keep old complete outgoing reachable union of anchors9373461 (30 nodes).

For every h4 root in ascending ID, retain one full-graph longest-path witness down to h0: choose among h-1 direct successors by fixed seeded draw, sorted IDs; reuse an already selected successor if available. Preserve all path nodes.

For h3 then h2 then h1, fill to fixed per-h quota by D-frequency rank quartiles of that h. Repeatedly pick from the least-filled available quartile, ties low to high quartile; fixed seeded draw among sorted remaining IDs.
If protected/path nodes exceed a quota, retain them and report the increase; no deletion of path nodes or re-selection based on geometry.
quartile_rule: Within each full Q h group sort by (D activation frequency,feature ID), split ranks into four nearly equal parts. Same frequency ties use feature ID; report as rank-strata, not disjoint exact-frequency intervals.
edges: ALL saved V reduced direct edges with both endpoints selected, including h-skipping edges; no new reduction. Raw passV edge table is support lookup only.
h: Frozen full V graph depth; never recomputed in display subgraph.
layout: Uniform node size, color by full h; reorder within each h using barycenter of displayed neighbors for crossing reduction only. Horizontal distance has no similarity meaning.
omitted_neighbors: Record full versus shown in/out degree per node; omitted neighbors do not mean absent relations.
geometry: AFTER selection JSON is frozen, use saved p and p_raw; same selected IDs, order h5 to h0 then stable layout order. New plot, not a new trend test.
overview: All15537Q nodes; one dot per Feature, fixed 200-column matrix within each h strip; h5 at top, h0 at bottom. Internal dot position is packing only.
